data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll the device (1-86400 seconds)
data_description.power_threshold: Minimum power change in watts before reporting a new state (0 = report every change, max 30s heartbeat)
data_description.phase_power_update_interval: Minimum interval between phase 1-3 power updates in seconds (0 = match polling interval)
data_description.power_avg_update_interval: Minimum interval between power average updates in seconds (0 = match polling interval)
data_description.energy_update_interval: Minimum interval between energy counter updates in seconds (0 = match polling interval)
data_description.diagnostic_update_interval: Minimum interval between diagnostic sensor updates (measurement age, Wi-Fi signal) in seconds (0 = match polling interval)
